subject: The one thing 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: I almost didn't include this feature. It's the secret weapon for the fastest results. Don't let your dog miss out.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. When I was building PupShape, I almost left out one entire section. I thought it was too simple, too obvious. I was wrong. It's become the single biggest predictor of whether a dog actually hits their target weight.

Here's the truth: tracking meals is one thing. But the real magic happens when you understand the *balance*. The exact ratio of nutrients that tells your dog's body to burn fat instead of storing it. Most users just fill out the meal plan and skip right past the tool that makes it work.

It's the Calorie Calculator for treats and meals. But not just for logging. It's for *planning*. You plug in your dog's favorite afternoon snack, and it instantly shows you how to adjust dinner so the day's total is perfect. No guesswork. No accidental overfeeding. This is the hack that turns good intentions into real, visible results on the scale.

Open the app right now. Tap 'Calculator' on the home screen. Put in one treat your dog had today. See the adjustment it recommends. That's the exact lever you pull for faster progress. P.S. The dogs who use this feature weekly lose weight 40% faster. No joke. It's that powerful.
